# TCPTimeouts <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
TCPTimeouts:Void read_millis:Int32, accept_millis:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `read_millis` | In | Int32 | required | Read timeout in milliseconds. |
| `accept_millis` | In | Int32 | required | Accept timeout in milliseconds. |

## Description

Sets how long to wait. Reading from a TCP stream waits for data until the read timeout is over, and [AcceptTCPStream](AcceptTCPStream) waits for a client until the accept timeout is over. The defaults are 10000 milliseconds for reading and 0 for accepting.
